valuation_methodology.primary: cycle-normalized forward P/E; 70% of scenario P/E value is based on 2026E EPS and 30% on 2027E EPS
valuation_methodology.secondary: P/B-ROE cross-check; 2026E BPS equals 2026Q1 BPS CNY9.572 plus EPS less assumed CNY0.08 dividend per share
valuation_methodology.reason_for_not_using_sotp: segment revenue and gross margin are disclosed, but segment net profit, cash flow and comparable segment multiples are not; a mechanical SOTP would add false precision
valuation_methodology.reason_for_not_using_peer_multiple: the case contains peer earnings aggregates but no verified peer price/EV multiple set on the same date; peer relative valuation has zero target weight

ev_ebitda_diagnostic_only.limitation: working-capital intensity, cash conversion and H1 segment economics are unverified; EV/EBITDA is not a target-price anchor

market_expectation_bridge.interpretation: Current price does not require multiple expansion in the House base case, but it requires H2 profit and cash conversion to be demonstrated; low external PE alone is not an entry signal.

direct_target_anchor.reason_for_zero_weight: single dated target and material EPS/assumption dispersion; it is a sensitivity reference, not a Street consensus or House valuation input

catalyst: formal H1 disclosure validates lithium volume, realised price, cost and H2 earnings bridge
positive operating cash flow with contained receivables and inventory
civil-explosives segment margin and collection disclosure supports defensive earnings
invalidation: formal H1 parent NP below preview range
continued material negative OCF with worsening working capital
H2 variables cannot support House bear-case CNY400m parent NP
model_reproducibility: PASS; arithmetic formulae and rounding conventions are documented in analysis/valuation_audit.md
evidence_quality: medium_low; 2025A/Q1 facts are L1, H1 NP preview is L1 preliminary, 2026-2027 operating assumptions are House inputs

rows.method: cycle-normalized P/E plus P/B-ROE cross-check; probability-weighted multi-anchor
rows.evidence_quality: medium_low; L1 historical and preliminary results plus House scenario assumptions
